summary: EuroDry Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for July 23, 2026, and furnishing the proxy statement, annual report on Form 20-F, proxy card, and notice-and-access card. The meeting is a routine annual shareholder event with no special-situation proposals such as acquisitions, divestitures, or going-private transactions. No deal terms or strategic actions are disclosed. This is a standard current report by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
